Focal predictor: total grass cover = ExoticAnnualGrass_cover + ExoticPerennialGrass_cover + NativePerennialGrass_cover (percent of quadrat). Model: OLS linear regression, euc_sdlgs_all ~ grass + Euc_canopy_cover + Distance_to_Eucalypt_canopy(m); native scale = seedlings per percentage-point of grass cover. Slope = -0.01312. Uncertainty: nonparametric cluster bootstrap resampling whole Properties (1000 reps), SE = 0.01603, percentile CI [-0.0484, 0.0129]; test statistic t = -0.82 with 17 df (clusters - 1). Earlier negative-binomial GEE fits (log and identity link) were rejected because they hit the iteration limit without convergence; the converged OLS fit is reported instead.
rows.predictor: Total grass cover (percent) = ExoticAnnualGrass_cover + ExoticPerennialGrass_cover + NativePerennialGrass_cover

rows.note: Negative binomial GLM (log link, alpha=19.5 chosen by profile likelihood over 4–40) of euc_sdlgs0_50cm (count of 0–50 cm eucalypt seedlings = recruitment cohort) on exotic grass cover (ExoticAnnualGrass_cover + ExoticPerennialGrass_cover, in units of 10 percentage points), adjusting for Euc_canopy_cover, Distance_to_Eucalypt_canopy(m), and Season factor (ref Autumn 2007). Missing predictor values imputed at column medians so all 351 rows retained (no exclusions). HC1 heteroskedasticity-robust SEs. Native effect on log-count scale: beta=-0.0752, SE=0.1527, z=-0.493, p=0.62; residual df=345; n=351 quadrat-visits (unit = one 15x15 m quadrat in one survey round); design = repeated cross-sectional survey across 18 properties, 3 rounds. Covariate dist: -0.0479 (SE 0.018).
rows.predictor: Exotic grass cover per 10 percentage points = (ExoticAnnualGrass_cover + ExoticPerennialGrass_cover)/10

rows.note: Data: data.csv, 351 quadrat-visits; grass cover operationalized as ExoticPerennialGrass_cover (competitively dominant grass class), not a summed total. Rows with missing grass/canopy/distance dropped (348 quadrat-visits), then aggregated to property x season units (n=54): predictors = mean cover, mean Euc_canopy_cover, mean distance to eucalypt canopy; outcome = summed euc_sdlgs_all (all three height classes) with log(number of quadrats) offset. Model: negative binomial MLE (log link, alpha=2.574 estimated), nonrobust covariance; within-property dependence handled by aggregating to property-season units (not cluster-robust SEs, not GEE). Focal quantity reported as a linear contrast: IQR increase (6.546 percentage points) in mean exotic perennial grass cover. Native scale = log expected seedlings per quadrat. Estimate -0.5939, SE 0.3056, z = -1.943, p = 0.052; large-sample z inference (df_resid = 50 available). Observation unit: property x season aggregate; design: repeated cross-sectional quadrat survey with fresh quadrats per round.
rows.predictor: IQR (6.546 percentage-point) increase in mean ExoticPerennialGrass_cover per property-season unit; larger = more grass cover

rows.note: Negative binomial GLM (log link, alpha=26.73 estimated from Poisson-fit auxiliary regression) of euc_sdlgs0_50cm (count of 0-50 cm eucalypt seedlings, the youngest recruit cohort) on grass cover, adjusting for Euc_canopy_cover, Distance_to_Eucalypt_canopy(m), and Season (3 rounds, factor). Exposure: total grass cover = ExoticAnnualGrass_cover + ExoticPerennialGrass_cover + NativePerennialGrass_cover, in raw percentage-point units (per 1 pp). Cluster-robust (Property, 18 clusters) SEs. Rows with missing values in model variables dropped: n=348 of 351 quadrat-visits (observation unit = one quadrat in one survey round; repeated-cross-section design, quadrats not persistent). Native scale: log expected count per 1 pp grass cover; coef -0.01259, SE 0.01065, z = -1.183, p = 0.237; Wald z inference (cluster-robust, effective df ~ 17 clusters); model df residual 342. Grass coefficient is negative but not statistically distinguishable from zero.
rows.predictor: Total grass cover (percent) = ExoticAnnualGrass_cover + ExoticPerennialGrass_cover + NativePerennialGrass_cover; per 1 percentage point

rows.note: Negative binomial GLM (log link, alpha=9.09 estimated by NB-2 MLE), outcome = total eucalypt seedlings (sum of 0-50cm, 50cm-2m, >2m) per quadrat-visit. Predictors: total exotic grass cover (ExoticAnnualGrass_cover + ExoticPerennialGrass_cover, percent), Euc_canopy_cover, Distance_to_Eucalypt_canopy(m). Missing cover values set to 0 (class absent); missing distance set to median. n=351 quadrat-visits (all rows), 18 properties; cluster-robust (Property) SEs. Focal: coef=-0.015084, SE=0.008512, z=-1.772, p=0.076, Wald z (large-sample, no finite df; 18 clusters). Design: repeated cross-sectional quadrat survey, unit = quadrat-visit.
rows.predictor: Total exotic grass percent cover = ExoticAnnualGrass_cover + ExoticPerennialGrass_cover; larger = more grass cover

rows.note: Binomial (logit) GLM of eucalypt seedling OCCURRENCE (1 if euc_sdlgs0_50cm + euc_sdlgs50cm_2m + euc_sdlgs>2m > 0; verified equal to euc_sdlgs_all) on ExoticPerennialGrass_cover (percent cover), with fixed effects for Property (18 levels) and Season (3 survey rounds); cluster-robust SEs by Property. Observation unit = one quadrat visit; n=350 (1 row dropped for missing cover); df_resid=329; z=-1.185, p=0.236. Native scale: log-odds per 1 percentage point of exotic perennial grass cover. Design: repeated cross-sectional survey, quadrats nested in properties (quadrats not persistent). Grass cover operationalized as exotic perennial grass cover alone (dominant exotic competitor class), not a summed grass index. No canopy/distance or climate covariates adjusted.
rows.predictor: ExoticPerennialGrass_cover (percent cover of exotic perennial grass in the quadrat)

rows.note: Linear mixed model (REML, statsmodels MixedLM): euc_sdlgs_all ~ grass + Euc_canopy_cover + Distance_to_Eucalypt_canopy(m), random intercept for Property (18 groups). Outcome = precomputed total seedling count across all three height classes (count scale, identity/additive). Predictor grass = ExoticAnnualGrass_cover + ExoticPerennialGrass_cover + NativePerennialGrass_cover (percent cover, requires all three non-missing). Exclusions: 3 rows with missing grass or covariates; n=348 quadrat-visits (one row = one quadrat in one round; properties recur across 3 rounds). Focal effect: -0.01462 seedlings per +1 percentage point total grass cover; SE 0.01526; test = Wald z = -0.958, p=0.338; df_resid=344; Group Var=1.775, Scale=36.85. Design: repeated cross-sectional quadrats clustered in properties; clustering handled by random property intercept.
rows.predictor: Total grass cover (percent) = ExoticAnnualGrass_cover + ExoticPerennialGrass_cover + NativePerennialGrass_cover

rows.note: Bayesian binomial mixed GLM (statsmodels BinomialBayesMixedGLM, VB fit), logit link: occ ~ NativePerennialGrass_cover with random intercept for Property (18 properties). Outcome occ = 1 if euc_sdlgs_all > 0 (any eucalypt seedling of any height class in the quadrat), else 0. Exposure = NativePerennialGrass_cover, percent cover of native perennial grass in the quadrat, raw percent units; coefficient is change in log-odds of seedling presence per 1 percentage point. No other covariates. 1 row dropped for missing cover; n = 350 quadrat-visits (observation unit = one 15x15 m quadrat in one survey round); design = repeated cross-sectional survey, quadrats nested in properties, non-persistent quadrats. Test statistic: posterior-mean/posterior-SD ratio z = 0.348 (approximate normal, no finite df; VB posterior). Random-effect log-SD posterior mean 0.358 (SD scale 1.43).
rows.predictor: NativePerennialGrass_cover (percent cover of native perennial grass per quadrat), higher = more grass cover

rows.note: Data: data.csv, 351 rows; 1 row dropped for missing grass cover -> n=350 quadrat-visits (unit = one 15x15 m quadrat in one survey round), 18 properties. Outcome: binary occurrence of small eucalypt recruits, recruit = 1 if euc_sdlgs0_50cm > 0 (11.7% positive). Exposure: ExoticPerennialGrass_cover (percent cover, continuous, per 1 percentage point). Model: linear mixed model (REML, statsmodels MixedLM) recruit ~ ExoticPerennialGrass_cover with random intercept for Property (handles within-property dependence); no other covariates. Native scale = risk difference per 1% cover: coef -0.002837, SE 0.001981, z = -1.432, p = 0.152; Wald z-test (large-sample, no finite df; residual df 348). Group Var 0.014, Scale 0.0918.
rows.predictor: ExoticPerennialGrass_cover (percent cover of exotic perennial grass in the quadrat), per 1 percentage point increase

rows.note: Linear mixed model (REML, statsmodels MixedLM): log1p(euc_sdlgs_all) ~ NativePerennialGrass_cover + Euc_canopy_cover + Distance_to_Eucalypt_canopy(m), random intercept for Property (18 groups). Observation unit = one quadrat-visit; n=348 after dropping rows missing any model variable (of 351). Native scale = change in log1p(total seedling count) per 1 percentage point of native perennial grass cover. Focal effect 0.001221, SE 0.002771, Wald z = 0.441 (p=0.66); df large-sample (z-test), 18 clusters. Design: repeated cross-sectional survey, quadrats nested in properties across 3 rounds.
rows.predictor: NativePerennialGrass_cover (percent cover of native perennial grass in the quadrat), used alone as the grass-cover exposure

Missing predictor values handled by single unconditional median imputation (no rows dropped). Native scale: log-odds per 1 percentage point grass cover = +0.00170, SE 0.00698, z=0.243, p=0.808; GEE robust z-test (large-sample, no finite df).
rows.predictor: Total grass cover (%) = ExoticAnnualGrass_cover + ExoticPerennialGrass_cover + NativePerennialGrass_cover; larger = more grass

rows.note: Negative binomial (NB2) MLE, log link: euc_sdlgs_all (total eucalypt seedlings, all three height classes, precomputed column) ~ ExoticPerennialGrass_cover + Euc_canopy_cover + Distance_to_Eucalypt_canopy(m) + C(Property) fixed effects (18 properties absorb within-property dependence structurally; model-based SEs). Grass cover operationalized as exotic perennial grass percent cover (competitively dominant grass class), in percentage points. Unit = quadrat-visit; n=348 after listwise deletion of 3 rows with missing cover/distance. Native effect: log-count coefficient -0.001997, SE 0.03304, z = -0.0604, p = 0.952, inferential df = large-sample normal (df_resid 327), NB alpha = 5.32. Design: repeated cross-sectional survey of fresh quadrats within properties over three seasons.
